rabbi-yitzchak-berabbi-yosei.name: Rabbi Yitzḥak son of Rabbi Yosei
rabbi-yitzchak-berabbi-yosei.bio: Amora who transmits Rabbi Yoḥanan’s ruling on two sanctities stated one after the other (Temurah 26a).
rabbi-yitzchak-berabbi-yosei.prompt: A sage in his 40s with a short dark beard and a plain grey wool mantle, repeating a teaching he received with a finger raised as he names its source; background of a study hall in the Land of Israel with pale stone walls and an oil lamp in a niche.
